content:
maria: quick heads-up — noticed console shows quota usage drop when a streaming response falls back to a toolcall and then truncates. dashboard shows less tokens than billing, users get confused :thinking:

alex: can you paste an example trace? which route + model?

maria: route=eu-prod->fallback-us, model=redwood/llama-70b-q4. timeline: client open stream, token stream to client until reconnect, server falls back to sync toolcall, truncation happens, billing shows full toolcall tokens, console shows only streamed prefix (truncated). logs:

```
[2025-11-03T12:01:05Z] request_id=abc123 route=eu-prod->us-fb stream_prefix_tokens=120
[2025-11-03T12:01:06Z] fallback_toolcall_tokens=560 confirmed=true
billing_event: provisional=false amount=560
console_ui: quota_displayed=120
```

leo: interesting. I think console strips provisional toolcall credits when they come from fallback in stream flow because it previously attributed to stream prefix. We probably collapse attribution by session_id and prefer earliest attribution. That causes under-reporting when fallback confirmed later.

nina: ops note: this is bad — customers seeing lower usage in UI but higher invoices. Need short-term mitigations.

sam: data: I pulled 32 sample events last 24h — 18% of those had provisional vs confirmed mismatch, median delta 380 tokens. I'll drop csv in #eng-analytics.

maria: short-term proposal: show two columns "displayed tokens (streamed)" and "confirmed tokens (billing)". Long-term: change attribution to keep provisional reserved until confirmed or reconciled.

alex: engineering question — do we have a unique session token to join stream and toolcall? currently we use session_id + sequence. If confirmed event arrives with different session due to routing it won't reconcile.

leo: runtime: we can add stitch_id to handoff. Minimal change: add "handoff_id" to toolcall confirmation and have router carry it. Then UI can merge.

nina: also suggest a UI flag "confirmed vs provisional" + tooltip. quick fix.

maria: can we push a tiny console change this week? PM priority.

alex: OK. I'll open an RFC and a small console PR to show provisional column. @billing-bot can we expose provisional flag in ledger events?

billing-bot: sure — exposing provisional boolean on /events is scheduled for next deploy 2025-11-10 (ETA).

sam: when RFC? I'll annotate analytics hooks to join on handoff_id.

leo: added note: watch out for race where confirmed arrives after invoice cutoff — need grace window and replay.

maria: agreed. action items: alex RFC + PR, leo runtime change to carry handoff_id, sam analytics csv and join hooks, nina console tooltip + flag. I'll ping customers if this looks like billing noise.

alex: thanks all. @maria can you drop a short blurb for support to use? one-liner.

maria: "Customers may see temporary UI vs invoice delta when a streaming request falls back to a synchronous toolcall; engineering is rolling out provisional indicators and reconciliation in the next 2 weeks." :thumbsup:
